summary: Phase 6 (DOMAIN-006 Payments + Escrow) backend + frontend testing. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_payments.py (21 tests) covering payment domain state machine, provider abstraction (Sandbox + LiqPay adapter unit-level with sig roundtrip + tampered rejection + build_provider selection), API checkout with immediate capture-into-escrow (sandbox), order->Paid choreography via PaymentCaptured event, buyer-only authorization (403 for seller/third party), 404 for missing order, idempotent double-checkout, service-level schedule_release_for_order + release_due sweeper, refund_for_order no-op + captured refund, and cancel-without-payment. Regression: full pytest suite = 64 passed, 3 failed (all in test_payments; all real Phase-6 bugs — see below). All 46 previously passing Phases 0-5 tests still green. Frontend E2E via Playwright confirmed the buyer /orders Pay-now flow with sandbox provider: click order-pay-<id> -> 'Payment captured — funds held in escrow' toast -> status badge flips to Paid on reload -> Pay/Cancel buttons removed. Seller /orders Sales tab shows the same order as Paid with 'Platform fee: ₴150 · You receive ₴1,350' breakdown.

critical.issue: Paying an order that is already Paid returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE instead of idempotent success. modules/payments/service.py checks snap.status != 'AwaitingPayment' BEFORE looking up existing captured payment; spec (review request) requires idempotent success returning the existing Captured payment_id when checkout is called on an already-Paid order. Fix: reorder the checks — first fetch repo.by_order(order_id); if existing.status in {Captured, Settled}, return that early; only then enforce AwaitingPayment for the create path.

TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. Payments are read back from Mongo with a naive release_at (Mongo strips tz), but domain.utc_now() returns tz-aware datetime, so is_release_due() raises inside the sweeper loop. The Mongo find() filter using $lte works (Motor normalizes), but the per-doc guard fails, so NO payment is ever released via the sweeper. Fix: normalize release_at on load (repo _from_doc should attach tzinfo=timezone.utc if naive) OR compare using naive UTC consistently.

issues: Status text renders as 'AwaitingPayment' / 'Paid' with no spacing — the AwaitingPayment badge is a solid orange chip which is fine, but the status_history breadcrumb 'Created → AwaitingPayment → Paid' shows 'AwaitingPayment' as one token. Minor readability; consider inserting a space ('Awaiting Payment').

action_items: Fix idempotent double-pay on Paid order (payments/service.py checkout ordering)

Fix tz-naive vs tz-aware datetime bug in Payment.is_release_due / repository load — currently the escrow sweeper CANNOT release any payment once release_at is set; this breaks the core Phase-6 feature.
critical_code_review_comments: modules/payments/service.py PaymentService.checkout(): status guard runs before idempotency lookup, causing 409 on already-Paid orders even though a captured payment exists. Reorder to prefer idempotency.

modules/payments/repository.py _from_doc(): release_at is loaded as-is from Mongo (naive datetime); domain.is_release_due compares against tz-aware utc_now() -> TypeError. Coerce to UTC-aware on read (also for audit.created_at/updated_at) or make utc_now naive-consistent.

modules/payments/service.py release_due() catches DomainError silently on repo.save; a CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT means a payment was raced — should at least log so operators know why payouts silently didn't happen.

modules/payments/service.py handle_webhook() accepts hold_completion/success/subscribed as capture triggers, but the LiqPay 'wait_secure' / 'wait_accept' statuses are not handled — real LiqPay production calls will drop these. Consider adding an explicit unknown-status branch that logs + no-ops.

modules/payments/provider.py LiqPayProvider assumes hold=True by default and the response 'auto_settle' is False, but there is no path to VOID or CAPTURE the hold from a UI action — capture_hold/void_hold exist but no service method calls them. Currently only the (async) webhook can settle a LiqPay hold — worth documenting in the ADR.
modules/orders/service.py mark_paid ignores orders not in AwaitingPayment (idempotent) but silently — no audit. If a race causes two PaymentCaptured events, the second is dropped without any trace.

modules/payments/router.py exposes /webhook/liqpay unauthenticated — correct (signed callback) but the signature verification happens inside PaymentService via provider.verify_callback which raises ValueError, NOT DomainError. That currently surfaces as a 500 to LiqPay. Wrap in a try/except to return 400.
modules/payments/service.py checkout() uses f'{snap.total / 100:.2f}' — for currencies with 0 or 3 decimal places (e.g., JPY, KWD) this is wrong. OK for UAH-only MVP but flag for i18n.
modules/payments/service.py release_due() finds by status/held/release_at filter and then re-loads each via by_id — this is O(2N) queries. Fine for MVP volume but consider a projection or batch.

Frontend testing tip: APIRequestContext SHARES cookies with the browser context — always call page.context.clear_cookies() before UI login if you did any API logins first, otherwise you'll be logged in as the wrong user.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1 (already-Paid checkout 409): service.py PaymentService.checkout enforces snap.status == 'AwaitingPayment' before checking if a captured payment already exists for the order. Once the outbox relay marks the order Paid (via PaymentCaptured -> mark_paid), a legitimate retry (e.g., user double-tap on Pay button before UI refresh) returns 409 instead of the idempotent Captured response the spec requires. Repro: create order -> checkout -> wait for Paid -> checkout again -> observe 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE. Fix: `existing = await self.repo.by_order(order_id); if existing and existing.status in ('Captured','Settled'): return {payment_id, status}` BEFORE the AwaitingPayment guard. Bug 2 (naive vs aware datetime): Mongo does not preserve tzinfo on datetimes retrieved via Motor. domain.utc_now() returns datetime.now(timezone.utc). is_release_due does `now >= self.release_at` where self.release_at is naive after a round-trip, raising TypeError. Repro: capture a payment via checkout -> call PaymentService.schedule_release_for_order -> call PaymentService.release_due() -> TypeError. Impact: escrow sweeper NEVER releases any real payment. Fix: in repository._from_doc coerce datetimes to UTC-aware: `release_at = d.get('release_at'); if release_at and release_at.tzinfo is None: release_at = release_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`.
